**t6 sizes**: got (8, 480) vs exp (8, 464).8 frames: 4 upstream ACKs (62 bytes each = 248) + 4 barrier results (58 bytes each = 232) = 480. My expectation 8*58=464 was wrong — ACKs are 62 bytes! 4*62+4*58 = 248+232=480 ✓ implementation correct. Test bug.

**t7 sent**: got [1,1,0,1] vs exp [1,0,0,1]. Hmm — broadcast root=2. Results go to nonroots 0,1,3 → sent=[1,1,0,1]! I wrote exp [1,0,0,1] by mistake — nonroot receivers are 0,1,3 all get results. sent[1]=1 correct. Also 't7 first emissions' [2,0,1,3,2] passed ✓ (ack r2, results d0,d1,d3, ack r2 repeat). And after that the effective... the ack r2 upto=1 — rank2 is nonreceiver, sent[2]=0 → ignored ✓ st check passed with 28=1 ✓. Test bug in my expectation.

**t8 failed**: got 0 vs exp 1. Let me re-analyze. Events: 4 data (p=0) mode 3 → acks to r0..r3 and results to all (sent=[1,1,1,1]). Then acks upto=1 from each → effective (len=1 ≤ sent=1) → ackd=[1,1,1,1]. Retire: b=1... K=1 → b=1, slots freed.

Then budget 0, flush: service → phase 1: pending upstream ACKs? E[r]=1=U[r], no repeat → none. Phase 3: sent[d]=1=out_len → nothing. So NO attempt → no failure! failed=0 ✓ implementation correct. My test expectation wrong — nothing was pending.

Then budget 1, retry rank 3: sets repeat[3] → phase 1: E[3]=1>0, E==U but repeat → upstream ACK to 3 → succeeds (budget 1). Phase 2: ackd[3]=1=sent[3] → no retransmissions. Phase 3: nothing. So tx_ack=5 total ✓ (4 + 1 repeat). tx_data=4 ✓. failed=0 ✓.

So all three "failures" are test-expectation bugs, and the implementation is right. Let me fix the test expectations to the correct values and re-run to keep the suite clean. Then continue with more hand tests (retry retransmission with unacked results, budget mid-opportunity, train).

cat >> /workspace/handtest.py <<'EOF'

# ---- Test 9: retry retransmission of sent-unacked results (mode 3) ----
ev=[{'op':'data','rank':r,'p':0,'values':[r+1]} for r in range(4)]
ev+=[{'op':'ack','rank':1,'upto':1}]            # only d=1 acked its result
ev+=[{'op':'retry','rank':0}]                   # retransmit d=0's unacked result q=0
ev+=[{'op':'retry','rank':3},{'op':'retry','rank':3}]  # d=3 retransmit twice
case={'primitive':'allreduce','mode':3,'root':0,'segments':1,'words':1,
      'capacity':1,'start':0,'events':ev,'trace':32}
out=run(case)
st=out['state']
check('t9 tx_data', st[20],4+1+2)      # 4 originals + 1 retransmit + 2 retransmits
check('t9 sent stays', st[6:10],[1,1,1,1])
check('t9 ackd', st[10:14],[0,1,0,0])
ranks=[t['rank'] for t in out['trace']]
check('t9 trace ranks', ranks,[0,1,2,3,0,3,3])
check('t9 retransmit frame same', out['trace'][4]['hex']==out['trace'][0]['hex'] or
      out['trace'][4]['hex'][108:116]=='0000000a', True)

# ---- Test 10: budget truncates an opportunity mid-stream, later service resumes ----
ev=[{'op':'data','rank':r,'p':0,'values':[1]} for r in range(4)]  # mode 3: 4 acks then results
# make budget=3 before the last contribution: ack r3 (1 emission) then results: 2 fit, 1 fails
ev=[{'op':'data','rank':r,'p':0,'values':[1]} for r in range(3)]
ev+=[{'op':'budget','n':3},{'op':'data','rank':3,'p':0,'values':[1]}]
ev+=[{'op':'snap','tag':'after-fail'}]
ev+=[{'op':'budget','n':-1},{'op':'flush'}]
case={'primitive':'allreduce','mode':3,'root':0,'segments':1,'words':1,
      'capacity':1,'start':0,'events':ev,'trace':32}
out=run(case)
sn=out['snapshots'][0]
st=sn['state']
check('t10 snap failed', st[29],1)
check('t10 snap tx', (st[20],st[21]),(2,4))    # ack r0..r3 + 2 results before failure
check('t10 snap sent', st[6:10],[1,0,0,0])    # sent prefix advanced only for d=0
st=out['state']
check('t10 final sent', st[6:10],[1,1,1,1])
check('t10 final failed', st[29],1)
check('t10 final tx', (st[20],st[21]),(4,4))
# trace: results after resume start again at q=sent[d]; d=1,2,3 q=0
check('t10 trace ranks', [t['rank'] for t in out['trace']],[0,1,2,3,0,1,2,3])

# ---- Test 11: train expansion sanity on allgather + reducescatter ----
ev=[{'op':'train','p':0,'count':4,'width':2,'ranks':[1,0,3,2],'seed':5}]
case={'primitive':'reducescatter','mode':3,'root':0,'segments':4,'words':1,
      'capacity':4,'start':2,'events':ev,'trace':0}
out=run(case)
st=out['state']
check('t11 rs accepted', st[22],16)      # 4 ranks x 4 p
check('t11 rs R', st[2:6],[4,4,4,4])
# acks: upto = clamp(end - r*K/4, 0, K/4) per chunk end 2 then 4
# r0: min(1,2-0)=1 then min(1,4)=1 -> ack upto1 twice (effective once)
# r1: 2-1=1 then 4-1=3->1 ; r2: 2-2=0 then 2 ; r3: 0 then 1
check('t11 rs ackd', st[10:14],[1,1,2,1])
check('t11 rs sent', st[6:10],[1,1,2,1])   # each p complete -> results q=p%1=0 ... hmm
print('   (t11 detail sent',st[6:10],'ackd',st[10:14],'U',st[14:18],'b',st[0],')')
EOF
